end.parentNote: Om practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting lines using pencils, a slide, and letter shapes. They explained the positions by describing lines as standing, lying down, or tilted, and identified examples such as A and T. They also discussed curved lines using a bangle and football; the straight-versus-curved distinction needed more support, though Om later gave correct curved-line explanations. At home, ask Om to find and name one standing, sleeping, slanting, and curved line around the house.
